Env: Found in waterlogged soil/coniferous woodland 
Gills: rust orange, relatively thick and distant. I would say sinuate
Cap: orange to brown, flattened with distinct and firm umbo
Stipe: fibrous and conical, fairly long in comparison to the stipe

Imported by Mushroom Observer 2024-10-26
